2609.01839.title: Import What You Need: Learning When and How to Augment EHR Graphs with External Knowledge
2609.01839.paper_summary: Longitudinal prediction from electronic health records (EHRs) is limited by the sparsity and irregularity in patient trajectories, and knowledge augmentation with external knowledge graphs (KGs) offers a promising way to alleviate these issues. However, most existing methods perform fixed, context-agnostic topology augmentation by adding the same KG nodes and edges regardless of a patient's evolving state. We propose ReTA, a Reinforcement learning-based dynamic Topology Augmentation framework that casts KG import as a per-visit, budget-aware policy. ReTA first constructs an offline refined pool of KG-grounded templates, then learns a policy to select one augment action per visit from three options: Soft Import, which enriches node features without modifying graph topology, Hard Import, which grafts a compact KG subgraph onto the visit graph to create message-passing shortcuts, and Skip, which leaves the visit unaugmented when the base encoder is already confident. To stabilize learning, ReTA employs a decoupled encoder that processes semantic and structural signals in separate channels and fuses them via adaptive gating. Experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV across diagnosis prediction, mortality, and readmission show that ReTA consistently outperforms strong baselines while remaining efficient, transfers across datasets and knowledge graphs, and yields interpretable augmentation patterns. The robust gains under sparse supervision highlight the advantage of ReTA's dynamic decision to import knowledge, boosting accuracy while curbing costs.
2609.01839.paper_summary_zh: 從電子健康記錄（EHRs）進行的縱向預測受到患者軌跡的稀疏性和不規則性的限制，而通過外部知識圖（KGs）進行知識增強提供了一種有前景的方法來緩解這些問題。<lb/>然而，大多數現有方法通過添加相同的KG節點和邊緣來執行固定的、與上下文無關的拓撲增強，而不考慮患者的演變狀態。<lb/>我們提出了ReTA，一種基於強化學習的動態拓撲增強框架，將KG導入視為每次訪問的、考慮預算的策略。<lb/>ReTA首先構建一個離線精煉的KG基礎模板池，然後學習一個策略，從三個選項中為每次訪問選擇一個增強行動：軟導入（Soft Import），在不修改圖拓撲的情況下豐富節點特徵；硬導入（Hard Import），將一個緊湊的KG子圖嫁接到訪問圖上以創建消息傳遞快捷方式；以及跳過（Skip），當基礎編碼器已經有信心時，將訪問保持不增強。<lb/>為了穩定學習，ReTA採用了一個解耦編碼器，分別處理語義和結構信號，並通過自適應閘融合它們。<lb/>在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV上進行的診斷預測、死亡率和再入院的實驗顯示，ReTA始終優於強基線，同時保持高效，能夠在數據集和知識圖之間轉移，並產生可解釋的增強模式。<lb/>在稀疏監督下的穩健增益突顯了ReTA動態決策導入知識的優勢，提升了準確性，同時降低了成本。
